summary: Preserve explicit service-account isolation with secure token storage, non-mutating previews, guarded MCP arguments, and policy-gated exact document reads.
reason: Automation needs named authentication without shell-global token changes, plaintext persistence, argv exposure, or silent account fallback. Document consumers need exact references and an explicit reveal gate instead of fuzzy lookup or automatic downloads.
validated_outcome: Regression coverage verifies account selection, child-only authentication, missing-token and Connect conflicts, profile/MCP exclusion, safe mutation previews and rollback, malformed MCP parameter rejection, token redaction, and exact-reference document reveal gates.
